newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PARLT SUPPORTS ENERGY VAT RISE IN 1ST READING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PARLT SUPPORTS ENERGY VAT RISE IN 1ST READING.

text.p: The Czech parliament on Friday approved the first reading of a government proposal to raise the value added tax (VAT) on energy to 22 percent from a previous five percent, the CTK news agency reported.
CTK said parliament approved the bill with 109 of the 192 deputies present voting in favour. The legislation now moves to the committee level for further debate prior to a final vote.
The hike in the energy VAT, if approved after a third reading, is slated to take effect on January 1, 1998.
The plan to hike VAT on energy is a part of a price deregulation plan aimed at bringing household prices in line with prices for industry, which are currently notably higher.
